source: Existing image-tile geometry in 11zzp_shot_grammar.js and temporalCinemaFocus in 11zzu_temporal_direction.js
scope: Matched OFF/ON decoded image features within the selected cinema field box at identical actual PTS, not whole-frame change or primary glyph drift
support: At least 6 forward/backward-valid tracks occupying at least 2 x bins and 2 y bins of a 2x2 selected field region; forward/back error <=0.5 pixel. Insufficient support is UNMEASURED, never PASS.
expectedTransform: Compute source crop sx/sy/cw/ch from exact Native input/output focus, same source dimensions, tile amount*sin(t*1.7), box and push factors. Map OFF feature position to ON position through the source crop equation. Fit a flow model only as a diagnostic, not as ground truth.
existingErrorCriterion: Per feature error <= max(0.5 pixel, 0.1 * expected feature displacement), identical to existing finalMotionObservation renderer agreement. Require >=0.9 agreement, existing renderer agreement requirement; no new aesthetic score.
mask: Selected field box intersect both image domains; remove registered primary glyph native+decoded bounds at current actual timestamp from OFF and ON feature support. Overlays/unknown target occlusion remain CONFOUNDED.
encodeNoise: Require ON_REPEAT control and original/ON compatibility; preserve independent RMS contribution test max(1,3*max(original-vs-ON noise, ON-vs-ON_REPEAT noise)). Noise cannot be ignored or attributed to camera intent.
mandatorySensorTestsBeforeActual: static background brightness flicker with expected movement
limits: Target feature agreement proves this image crop transform at sampled actual times, not aesthetic merit, all camera semantics, synchronization, all scenes or release QUALITY_GO. Insufficient feature support or unmodeled layers remains UNMEASURED/CONFOUNDED. Keep historical primary settle FAILED unchanged.
